contrasts.line: Furious is intense and explosive; grumpy is just a sour scowly state.
Furious bursts out hot and strong; resentful stays inside for a long time.
Grumpy is low and crabby; furious is much stronger and louder.
Grumpy is a sour state now; resentful carries a grudge from before.
Resentful is held inside over time; furious bursts out with huge force.
Resentful remembers a past slight; grumpy is just a sour state.
Frustrated means a real try keeps failing; grumpy is a scowly mood with no clear cause.
Frustrated is about being blocked from a goal; jealous is wanting what someone else has.
Frustrated is about a try failing right now; resentful looks back at an old sting.
Frustrated is a groan at a stuck thing; furious is a full boiling blow-up.
Grumpy is a cross mood about nothing in particular; frustrated needs a goal that keeps failing.
Jealous means someone else has the thing you long for; frustrated means your own try keeps failing.
Resentful is quiet anger about a past wrong; frustrated is about a task refusing to work now.
Furious is huge, hot anger; frustrated is the smaller ache of a try that will not work.
Jealous points at what another person has; grumpy is just a scowly mood from nowhere.
Jealous wants what someone else has; resentful broods over a wrong already done.
Jealous is a quiet wanting ache; furious is loud, boiling anger.
Grumpy is a general bad mood; jealous needs someone else to have the thing you wish was yours.
Resentful is about being treated badly before; jealous is about wanting what another has now.
Furious is exploding anger in the moment; jealous is the wish for what someone else has.
